starting_state: Illustrative late point during already-ongoing slow cooling of prepared alum mother liquor, with a few visible crystals. All reagent dissolution and earlier cooling occur before this reference; crystal sizes are illustrative.
scope: Short real-time late-cooling observation excerpt only. Not immediate nucleation, time-lapse, full crystal yield, filtration or completion of the entire cooling process.

clips.name: alum_cooling
clips.action: Hold the existing beaker stationary at a late point of slow cooling and show a short real-time observation of the existing alum crystals in clear mother liquor.
clips.state_before: Clear prepared mother liquor with a few existing colourless faceted crystals, no heater.
clips.state_after: Existing crystals remain in the mother liquor; only gradual physically plausible growth is allowed. No sudden pile, boiling, new reagent, bulk-white suspension or invented yield.
